other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage in Blending
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the exact same validation set for both early stopping of base models and for learning the weights of the ensemble blend. Because the base models' predictions are already overfitted to the validation set via early stopping, the blending optimisation becomes biased and optimistic. Out-of-fold predictions from cross-validation should be used instead.

summary: The agent implements an advanced pipeline with solid feature engineering, proper dataset splitting, and diverse model architectures including deep learning. However, it fails to average multiple runs for stochastic models (FM14) and relies on a single evaluation metric (FM15). Most notably, it introduces validation leakage by using the same validation set for early stopping and ensemble weight optimisation.
